title: Ankita Bhandari's parents stage sit-in at Rajghat
seoTitle: Delhi: Parents of Ankita Bhandari protest

tea.why: The parents of a 2022 murder victim are protesting to demand further investigation into alleged links between a VIP and the crime.
tea.want: A thorough investigation into the alleged involvement of a VIP in the 2022 murder of their daughter.
tea.changed: Nov 5: Police removed the parents and two others from the Rajghat memorial site after they refused to disperse from a non-designated area.

summary: On November 5, 2026, the parents of Ankita Bhandari, who was murdered in Uttarakhand in 2022, staged a sit-in (dharna) near the public gate of the Rajghat memorial in New Delhi. Accompanied by two others, the parents were protesting to demand a deeper investigation into the murder case, specifically regarding allegations that an unidentified VIP was involved. According to police sources, the group was removed from the site because it is not a designated protest area and they refused requests to disperse. Police stated that the individuals were not detained. During the incident, the victim's mother reported health issues and was taken to a hospital, where she was later joined by Aam Aadmi Party MLA Sanjeev Jha before departing with him.
demands: Investigation into the alleged involvement of a VIP in the 2022 murder case
response: Police stated the group was removed from the site because it was not a designated protest area and they refused to disperse. Authorities confirmed the individuals were not detained. Source: 1, 2

updates.text: The parents of the murder victim staged a sit-in at Rajghat and were subsequently removed by police.
